title: Finite elemente modeling of the crushing of carbon composite plates using implicit and explicit integration schemes.
author: Alexandre Muniz Neves
abstract: The difficulty in predicting the failure mechanics when a laminate suffers an impact makes the project of impact-resistant composite structures become a challenge. The objective of this study is to contribute in identifying these mechanics by means of a finite element model capable of representing failure modes in carbon fiber specimens suffering dynamic compression. The model was built under the commercial code Samcef. This study followed an extensive essay campaign, which is explained in detail before the hypotheses used in the FE model are assessed. The models were solved by direct integration in time, using explicit and implicit schemes. Some of the phenomena involved in the compression of the specimens are represented in accordance with the essays. The results are then compared with the experimental data.
